text: `global ... [T] dynamic @factory init("id")` shall require one nonempty program-wide ID and a direct non-variadic zero-parameter factory returning exactly one T. The factory may declare one raised type. Optional `after` shall list prerequisites; optional shutdown shall be a supported-ABI fixed non-raising zero-parameter/zero-result function.
